definitions.supplemental: bú = bá both, tú = twá two

quotations.english: then both [the two] shall be preserved

quotations.old_english: Ðá bútú abulgon Isaace and Rebeccan
quotations.english: then both [the two] were a grief to Isaac and Rebecca
we both [lit. we two both] speak to him
where they both [lit. they two both] sat

source_text: bútú [bú = bá both, tú = twá two] Both; ambo :-- Ðonne beóþ bútú gehealden then both [the two] shall be preserved, Mk. Bos. 2, 22. Ðá bútú abulgon Isaace and Rebeccan then both [the two] were a grief to Isaac and Rebecca, Gen. 26, 35: Lk. Bos. l, 6, 7. Wit him bútú sprecaþ we both [lit. we two both] speak to him, Cd. 27; Th. 36, 20; Gen. 574: 39; Th. 52, 4; Gen. 838: 40; Th. 52, 22; Gen. 847. Ðǽr hie sǽton bútú where they both [lit. they two both] sat, 133; Th. 168, 8; Gen. 2779. v. bátwá.
